cases.summary: Creates and validates an accessible architecture diagram.
cases.setup: Provide a small architecture description, target output path, project color tokens, and explicit trust boundaries.
cases.prompt: Create an editable SVG architecture diagram showing services, direction, protocols, and trust boundaries.
expectedBehavior: Discovers svg-generate rather than D3 or infographic-builder.
Uses project tokens, semantic groups, unique IDs, title, description, and labeled connections.
Runs validate_svg.py successfully and inspects the rendered output when supported.
forbiddenBehavior: Omits accessible text or trust labels.

cases.summary: Repairs a dense SVG with overlapping labels.
cases.setup: Provide an editable SVG fixture with valid XML but visibly overlapping node and edge labels at delivery dimensions.
cases.prompt: Make this diagram readable at its intended size without dropping required labels.
expectedBehavior: Inspects the visual artifact, not XML alone.
Adjusts layout, wrapping, grouping, or dimensions while preserving meaning.
Reruns structural validation and verifies clipping and overlap visually.
forbiddenBehavior: Deletes required content to make space without approval.
Claims the parser proves visual legibility.

cases.summary: Finds and fixes structural accessibility failures.
cases.setup: Provide an SVG missing title and description, using duplicate IDs, a broken marker reference, and color-only risk categories.
cases.prompt: Audit and repair this SVG's structure and accessibility, then validate it.
expectedBehavior: Adds meaningful root title and description.
Repairs duplicate IDs and broken references.
Adds redundant category labels or shapes and passes validate_svg.py.
forbiddenBehavior: Claims assistive-technology testing that was not run.
